relevance.rationale: Join CORRECT (arXiv:math/0511710v2, Baez-Schreiber, 'Higher Gauge Theory', matching the registered entry). BIB ORPHAN: a full-tree grep returns zero citation sites in content/; the only hits are library/sm-uploads-intake.json:39,68 and docs/audits/2026-08-01-sm-uploads-round2-reads.md:42, i.e. intake records, not citations. This is the highest-value orphan in the slice, because the corpus is citing the WRONG paper for content this one contains: emergence-to-quantum-flat.lean:36,63 cites [baez2004] (Baez-Lauda, 2-Groups) for the quantum-flatness / instanton-equation / simplicity-constraint claim, and Baez-Lauda contains none of that. This document does: its abstract states that a 2-connection allows parametrisation-independent parallel transport along paths and surfaces, and that in Breen-Messing terms this requires the fake curvature to vanish; the body develops the point (2-connections on principal 2-bundles are equivalent to Breen-Messing connections on nonabelian gerbes precisely when the fake curvature vanishes, and that condition forces H = dB + d alpha(A) ^ B to be constrained). One caveat the folio must carry if it cites this: the abstract says 'we summarize the main results of our theory without proofs'.

keyResults.locator: Abstract; and the vanishing-fake-curvature discussion in the body
keyResults.statement: A 2-connection on a principal 2-bundle gives parametrisation-independent parallel transport along surfaces exactly when the fake curvature vanishes; this is the condition matching Breen-Messing connections on nonabelian gerbes.
keyResults.useForFolio: This is the actual source for the flatness condition that prop:emergence-to-quantum-flat currently attributes to baez2004; citing it fixes a wrong-source citation and gives the F = B / F^- = 0 discussion a real 2-gauge-theoretic footing.
